{{Top|leg}}
The '''Baragwin shield disruptor''' was a [[shield disruptor]] that had been modified by the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] to have ability to be powered by a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] own power supply. This had the effect of eliminating the need to replace the device.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
